title: Caldova process ontology
intro: Caldova Industrial AG is fictitious. The ontology proposes business objects for four journeys and a shared vocabulary for data and operations agents. Dynamics 365 and IoT bindings are synthetic proposals. SAP routes and dependent bindings remain unresolved and conditional: source support, Fabric capacity, SAP Datasphere environment, Premium Outbound Integration and ADLS Gen2 permissions are unknown. Mirroring is only a candidate for supported sources through SAP Datasphere and ADLS Gen2, not a generic S/4HANA or ECC route. The read-only SQL route and any commercial entitlement remain to confirm; no real estate, access or publication is verified.

entity_types.name: Customer
entity_types.description: An organisation that buys products or services; one record per sold-to party.

standard.note: Business that represents a customer or potential customer; the company that is billed in business transactions.

entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: A sellable or purchasable item, machine type or service product; one record per material number.

standard.note: Information about products and their pricing; the parent product is the product family.

entity_types.name: Employee
entity_types.description: A person working for the company in a role that the process needs (owner, approver, technician). Bound to the HR system once it is named (to confirm in the IT readiness workshop).

related: Worker in the HR system of record
standard.note: People who do the work are bookable resources in Dataverse; the HR system of record stays the master for employment data (to confirm with HR). Model people only in the roles the process needs.

entity_types.name: Site
entity_types.description: A physical location: customer site, plant, warehouse or office.

related: Functional location (msdyn_functionallocation) for where an asset is installed
standard.note: Location or branch office where an organization does business.

entity_types.name: Lead
entity_types.description: A sales signal not yet qualified: inbound request, event contact or tender notice.

standard.note: Prospect or potential sales opportunity; converted into accounts, contacts or opportunities when qualified. The first response time is a custom attribute.

entity_types.name: Opportunity
entity_types.description: A qualified chance to sell, with value, stage and expected close date.

standard.note: Potential revenue-generating event or sale to an account, tracked through a sales process.

entity_types.name: Quote
entity_types.description: A priced offer to a customer, with lines, discounts and validity.

standard.note: Formal offer for products and services at specific prices and payment terms. The sent date is a custom attribute.

entity_types.name: Sales order
entity_types.description: A confirmed customer order, handed over to fulfilment.

standard.note: Quote that has been accepted; when the ERP owns the order, the silver layer conforms it to this shape.

entity_types.name: Supplier
entity_types.description: An organisation the company buys from; one record per vendor number.

standard.note: Name and addresses come from the party the vendor references; an ERP other than finance and operations is conformed to this shape in the silver layer.

entity_types.name: Legal entity
entity_types.description: A company code that books, reports and pays.

standard.note: Attribute names to verify in the table definition.

entity_types.name: Purchase requisition
entity_types.description: A request to buy, with requester, category and amount.

standard.note: Table and attribute names to verify in the Common Data Model reference.

entity_types.name: Purchase order
entity_types.description: A commitment to a supplier for goods or services.

standard.note: Table and attribute names to verify in the Common Data Model reference.

entity_types.name: Contract
entity_types.description: An agreement with a supplier: prices, terms, validity and renewal date.

standard.note: Purchase agreements in finance and operations; a contract management system stays the master for the document itself. To verify.

entity_types.name: Goods receipt
entity_types.description: The confirmed receipt of goods or services against an order.

standard.note: Table and attribute names to verify in the Common Data Model reference.

entity_types.name: Supplier invoice
entity_types.description: An invoice from a supplier, matched against order and receipt.

standard.note: Attribute names to verify in the table definition.

entity_types.name: Asset
entity_types.description: A machine or installation at a customer or plant, tracked over its life (installed base).

standard.note: Extends the Dynamics 365 customer asset; msdyn_deviceid links the asset to its IoT device and msdyn_parentasset builds the asset hierarchy.

entity_types.name: Service request
entity_types.description: A request for service from a customer, an alarm or a planned maintenance plan.

standard.note: Service request case associated with a contract.

entity_types.name: Work order
entity_types.description: The planned job to fix or maintain an asset: skills, parts and schedule.

standard.note: Stores the work done for an account: incident details, resources, tasks, billing; links to the customer asset and the IoT alert. First-time fix is derived.

entity_types.name: Service report
entity_types.description: The technician's report of a visit: findings, work done, parts used, confirmed by the technician.

standard.note: No standard table: the technician's confirmed report is a custom table in the service domain, linked to the work order and the booking.

entity_types.name: Spare part
entity_types.description: A part used or needed on a job, with availability.

standard.note: A spare part is a product held in stock; stock levels come from the ERP or warehouse inventory.

entity_types.name: Alarm event
entity_types.description: A live alarm or telemetry event from an asset (time series).

standard.note: Only actionable alerts reach Dataverse (with msdyn_customerasset, msdyn_case and msdyn_workorder links); raw telemetry stays in the eventhouse. msdyn_alertpriorityscore (0 to 100) carries the priority.

entity_types.name: Ledger account
entity_types.description: A general ledger account in the chart of accounts.

standard.note: Table and attribute names to verify in the Common Data Model reference.

entity_types.name: Journal entry
entity_types.description: A posting to the ledger, with amount, period and source.

standard.note: Line level; the posting date and period come from the general journal entry header (GeneralJournalEntry), the account from MainAccount.

entity_types.name: Reconciliation
entity_types.description: The reconciliation of an account for a period, with open items and preparer.

standard.note: Held in the close or reconciliation tool; model as a custom table in the finance domain.

entity_types.name: Close task
entity_types.description: A task in the period-end close calendar with owner, due date and status.

standard.note: Held in the close calendar or checklist; model as a custom table in the finance domain.

entity_types.name: Cost center
entity_types.description: An organisational unit that collects costs.

standard.note: Cost centers are values of a financial dimension; to verify.

entity_types.name: Service contract
entity_types.description: A customer agreement for service on assets: coverage, response time (SLA) and validity.

related: Field Service agreement for recurring maintenance
standard.note: Agreement to provide customer service during a specified time or number of cases.

relationship_types.name: includes_service
relationship_types.description: The service attach of a machine order.

rules.text: Approval seam (Commercial): Every quote, every discount outside guidelines and every contractual commitment is approved by a person before it reaches the customer.
Approval seam (Procurement): Every requisition is confirmed by the requester; every award, contract deviation and purchase above the delegation of authority is approved by a person.
Approval seam (Service): The technician confirms every report; the planner approves every dispatch; nothing changes a customer contract without a person.
Approval seam (Finance): No posting, payment or published figure without a person signing it off.
A service report is complete only when the technician has confirmed it; an unconfirmed report never triggers an invoice.
A purchase order counts as on contract only if it references a contract valid on the order date with the same supplier.
A supplier invoice is blocked when price or quantity differ from the order and the goods receipt by more than the agreed tolerance.
Lead response time runs from the first customer contact to the first qualified answer, in working hours.

metrics.name: Lead response time
metrics.definition: Hours from first signal to qualified response

metrics.name: Quote cycle time
metrics.definition: Days from qualified need to sent quote

metrics.name: Quote accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of quotes sent without later correction

metrics.name: Service attach rate
metrics.definition: Share of new installations sold with a service contract

metrics.name: Spend under management
metrics.definition: Share of spend through negotiated channels

metrics.name: Maverick buying rate
metrics.definition: Share of indirect spend outside catalogues and contracts

metrics.name: Requisition cycle time
metrics.definition: Hours from need to approved requisition

metrics.name: Tail spend negotiated
metrics.definition: Share of tail spend under negotiated terms

metrics.name: Second-visit rate
metrics.definition: Share of cases needing more than one visit

metrics.name: Time to confirmed report
metrics.definition: Minutes from job end to confirmed report

metrics.name: Invoice lead time
metrics.definition: Days from job end to invoice

metrics.name: First-time fix rate
metrics.definition: Share of cases fixed on the first visit

metrics.name: Days to close
metrics.definition: Working days from period end to closed books

data_agents.name: Commercial Data Agent
data_agents.description: Answers questions about the Lead-to-Order Journey in business terms: Customer, Product, Employee, Site, Lead, Opportunity, Quote, Sales order, Asset.
data_agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

questions.q: Which leads received this week have no response yet, and who owns them?
What is the average quote cycle time by product group over the last 12 weeks?
Which open opportunities above the deal-desk threshold have had no activity for 14 days?
Which customers ordered machines last quarter without a service contract?
How did lead response time develop by month over the last six months?
How did quote cycle time develop by month over the last six months?

data_agents.name: Procurement Data Agent
data_agents.description: Answers questions about the Source-to-Pay Journey in business terms: Supplier, Product, Employee, Legal entity, Purchase requisition, Purchase order, Contract, Goods receipt, Supplier invoice.

questions.q: Which purchase orders last month were placed outside a contract, by category?
What is the requisition-to-order cycle time by channel this quarter?
Which contracts expire in the next 90 days and how much spend runs through them?
Which supplier invoices are blocked for more than five days, and why?
How did spend under management develop by month over the last six months?
How did maverick buying rate develop by month over the last six months?

data_agents.name: Service Data Agent
data_agents.description: Answers questions about the Request-to-Resolution Journey in business terms: Customer, Asset, Employee, Product, Site, Service request, Work order, Service report, Spare part, Alarm event.
data_agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

questions.q: Which assets had more than two alarms in the last 30 days and no open work order?
What is the first-time fix rate by region and work type this quarter?
Which confirmed service reports from last week still have no invoice?
questions.query: SELECT r.serviceReportId, w.workOrderId, r.confirmedAt FROM fs_servicereport r JOIN fs_workorder w ON w.workOrderId = r.workOrderId LEFT JOIN sap_billing b ON b.workOrderId = w.workOrderId WHERE r.confirmedAt >= DATEADD(day, -7, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND b.invoiceId IS NULL

questions.q: Which technicians are certified for the asset models with the most open requests?
How did second-visit rate develop by month over the last six months?
How did time to confirmed report develop by month over the last six months?

data_agents.name: Finance Data Agent
data_agents.description: Answers questions about the Record-to-Report Journey in business terms: Legal entity, Employee, Ledger account, Journal entry, Reconciliation, Close task, Cost center.

questions.q: Which close tasks for this period are overdue, and who owns them?
Which accounts have reconciling items older than 60 days?
What explains the variance above 5% on the top ten cost centers this month?
How did days to close develop by month over the last six months?
How did open reconciling items develop by month over the last six months?

operations_agents.name: Service watch
operations_agents.goal: Act on live signals before the customer notices: Machine alarms and telemetry from the installed base as live events (IoT platform to confirm)
rules: When an asset raises an alarm of high severity and has no open service request, recommend opening one with the alarm context.
When the same alarm repeats three times within 24 hours, recommend a remote diagnosis before a visit.
